status_as_of_cutoff: inactive / withdrawn as of 2026-08-11 refresh. Missoula County's Bonner Data Center page states the building owner withdrew his signature from the Krambu special exception application and that the project will not move forward. The county also reports a separate countywide moratorium on permitting new or expanded data centers outside city limits from 2026-07-09 through 2027-07-08 or replacement zoning.
evidence_grade: A-official county project page for location/capacity/withdrawal and official county moratorium page for interim zoning; local reporting used to date the withdrawal.

contradictions.details: Official county page states about 7 MW initially with potential to expand to 29 MW, while Montana Free Press reports the application discussed possible ramp-up to 100 MW depending on ultimate power availability and market demand. Treat 7/29 MW as county-verified proposal capacity and 100 MW as applicant/projected tail, not approved capacity.

Official county page attributes withdrawal to the building/site owner and says the project will not move forward; local headlines variously say Krambu withdrew the application or the project is dead. The refreshed status uses the official county wording.

history.status_as_of_cutoff: Missoula County announced interim zoning to pause new or expanded data centers outside city limits, and the county’s public information page records the July 9 hearing/action context. Reporting says the property owner withdrew support before the pause; no final project land-use approval, building permit, construction, or utility record was located.
